pages.text: The Upgrade Station adds special abilities to Akaishi gear: inserting 1 $(l:akaishi:upgrade_template)Upgrade Template$(/l) and 20M Akaishi Energy, and spending 1 upgrade slot on the gear, increases the chosen ability by +1 level.$(br2)The number of abilities a piece can carry depends on its remaining upgrade slots.

$(bold)General abilities (up to level 3):$(reset)$(li)Lifesteal$(li)Knockback Resistance$(li)Movement Speed$(li)Fire Resistance$(li)Blast Protection$(li)Fall Protection$(br2)These apply to any slot and any piece of Akaishi gear; repeating the same ability increases its level.

$(bold)Per-slot abilities (1 level cap):$(reset)$(li)Helmet: Haste + Water Breathing$(li)Chestplate: Resistance + Hit Regen$(li)Leggings: Jump Boost + Swim Speed$(li)Boots: Slow Falling + Speed$(br2)$(bold)Tools and sword:$(reset)$(li)Pickaxe/Shovel/Axe: Area Break (1 level)$(li)Sword: Essence Drop (up to level 3)$(br2)Slot-locked abilities only apply to the matching piece; assigning them to other gear has no effect.
Recast gear at the $(l:akaishi:equipment_forger)Equipment Forger$(/l) first, then spend Templates here. Template sources and disambiguation are in $(l:akaishi:upgrade_template)Upgrade Template$(/l).
